# System packages for building and running Terra on Ubuntu 24.04 (noble).
# CI installs exactly this list (.github/workflows/ci.yml); README "Building on Linux"
# points friends here. One package per line; `#` starts a comment.
#
# winit and wgpu load every graphics library at runtime (dlopen), so only the first
# group is needed to *build*. The rest is needed to *run*, and a desktop install
# already has most of it.

# Build: C toolchain for build scripts and the linker driver, pkg-config for -sys crates.
build-essential
pkg-config

# Graphics: the Vulkan loader, and Mesa's Vulkan drivers (Intel, AMD, and the lavapipe
# software renderer that CI uses). NVIDIA users install the proprietary driver instead.
libvulkan1
mesa-vulkan-drivers
# EGL, for wgpu's OpenGL ES fallback.
libegl1

# Windowing and keyboard: Wayland, X11 and xkbcommon, loaded by winit.
libwayland-client0
libxkbcommon0
libxkbcommon-x11-0
libx11-6
libx11-xcb1
libxcb1
libxcursor1
libxrandr2
libxi6

# Diagnostics: `vulkaninfo --summary` shows which GPUs Vulkan can see.
vulkan-tools
